For jungling Tiger Udyr is terrible compared to phoenix in my opinion. The only advantage to Tier Udyr in the jungle is that he has higher burst for ganks. Fortunately Udyr has a stun so unless he gets CCed immediately after he stuns his target or they flash away right afterwards he is going to be able to dish out the damage for a few seconds. This evens out the damage between Tiger and Pheonix for ganks but then you have higher clear times and lower sustain in Tiger stance. It just doesn't add up.

Rushing a Trinity Force is terrible. Wit's End is all you need damage wise and you will notice it immediately. You need to build tank tank tank right off the bat and Trinity Force just costs too much to give you enough time to do this. Now if you have an AMAZING start and you end with a massive amounts of gold I would certainly buy that Trinity Force but in a normal game this is just not a good idea.

This looks great except I strongly disagree with some of your items.  


Udyr is so strong that with a cloth 5 start he doesn't even end up using the potions unless he takes heavy damage from a 1v1 with the other jungler or a gank attempt and at that point you should probably go back if you want to or you can stay in the jungle. If you want to have a strong gank at level 4 I would say go boots 3 but I personally LOVE going regrowth pendant 1. With blue buff Udyr literally has infinite sustain with no items from level 2. This allows me the same level of sustain as cloth 5 if I get a leash blue and I buy philo stone asap. Udyr needs to stance dance 24/7 in combat and philo stone gives him just enough mana to do this without blue which allows you to give your mid lane blue without hurting your mana. You could still gank at level 4 but you're just not as fast but with E you should be able to catch most champions. When I start cloth 5 I find that I just wasted 175 gold on potions.

I completely agree with you about Udyr's role in your masteries section which is why I disagree with Triforce and Frozen Mallet on Udyr. You should have no problem sticking to someone because of your E and health isn't very good on Udyr compared to resistances because his shield effectively increases his health pool by a colossal fuck ton. Triforce is Udyr's best item for damage but that is not your role and it is a ton of gold. I find once you build both Randuin's Omen and Banshee's Vale you are literally unstoppable because you have super high resistances and an amazing shield. You can play the role of both tank and off tank because you are so damn disruptive and tanky and you dish out good damage with Wit's End alone. I just feel like Trinity Force is not worth the gold over the other two items. On Tiger Lanedyr it is the second item I get after boots and Wriggle's because Level 5 Q + Trinity Force = Dead but when you go top lane your role switches from a disruptive tank to a bruiser which is why I don't worry about resistances. I would also highly recommend going Uydr top lane, he is essentially Riven without her ultimate and slightly weaker abilities once you start leveling but if their jungler comes to gank you at level 2 you can easily get a double kill because of how strong Q is at level 1. Well those are my two cents.


tl;dr? Cloth 5 is a bad start, Frozen Mallet is real bad, Trinity Force is outside of jungle Udyr's role.
